author: andrewgcodes
name: Optimized Architecture v6
blurb: SP-1024 10x512 KV4 with optimized bigram (2048x64), MLP 3x, SWA (every 50 steps), RoPE, Muon weight decay (0.08), 10-layer architecture with Int5 MLP quantization, enhanced test-time training (5 epochs SGD lr=0.003, freeze 5 layers), sliding window eval (stride=64), and int8+zlib roundtrip.
